Washington will need to establish a consistent offensive rhythm and limit turnovers against a Chicago team coming off an impressive performance.
 The Bulls return home after securing a 132-125 victory over the Bucks on Friday night, bouncing back from a 135-92 loss to Toronto in their season opener. Chicago showed significant improvement offensively in its second game and will look to carry that momentum into Saturday's matchup. With both teams playing on the second night of a back-to-back, execution, defensive intensity, and contributions from the bench could make the difference in this Eastern Conference showdown.
